module.title: Matrices, Linear Maps & Linear Systems
module.destination: Treat real matrices as basis-dependent representations of finite-dimensional linear maps; compose maps, solve and classify exact linear systems, reason with column space/null space/rank/invertibility, use determinants with correct scope, and change coordinates/similar representations without importing projection, eigenstructure or numerical-conditioning machinery.
module.gate: Nineteen sessions and 38 fixed assessments authored on the pedagogical branch under protocol v1.2. Builder verification and pilot/full-module semantic audits are required before any learner-route publication; page completion alone is not mastery.
module.nextBoundary: M15/SIDE278 owns projection, Gram–Schmidt and least squares; M16/SIDE279 owns eigenstructure; M17/SIDE280 owns PSD/QR/Cholesky/SVD.

owns: finite real linear maps and basis-dependent matrix representations
matrix-vector action, composition and matrix multiplication with dimension/order semantics
linear systems, equivalent row operations, echelon structure and complete exact solutions
column space/image, null space/kernel, rank, nullity and rank-nullity
injectivity, surjectivity, square invertibility and exact inverse construction
determinant algebra, singularity and real oriented volume interpretation
vector coordinate changes and similar matrix representations of one operator
excludes: M15 orthogonal projection, Gram–Schmidt and least squares
M16 eigenvalues, eigenvectors, characteristic polynomials and diagonalization
M17 PSD/quadratic forms, QR, Cholesky, SVD and pseudoinverse
M23 floating-point conditioning, numerical rank, pivoting/stability and numerical LU/QR algorithms
M18–M19 Jacobians, Hessians and matrix calculus
infinite-dimensional, complex spectral or general operator theory
boundary.decisiveProhibition: Use finite real exact linear algebra only. Do not use projection/least-squares, eigenvalue/diagonalization, factorization/pseudoinverse or numerical-conditioning machinery as premises for M14 claims.

semanticSeparationAudit.note: Each fixed task was compared against its lesson, worked example, guided action/feedback and earlier answer-bearing instruction by mathematical instance, not prompt text alone. Transfer labels state the changed representation/decision/obstacle. Full-module cross-session scan is repeated in verification.

localBridges: S01 locally defines the map/composition language needed despite no separate formal function-module dependency
S06 proves exact row-operation equivalence before systematic elimination is consumed
S15 states a bounded finite determinant existence/uniqueness characterization before using its consequences
S16 labels volume/orientation as a theorem/interpretation rather than the determinant definition
S17 builds change of basis as the identity map between coordinate systems before S18 similarity

instructionSeparation.policy: Worked/guided examples use distinct numerical or structural instances from fixed assessments. Guided feedback remains staged. Fixed assessments are compared semantically against all earlier answer-bearing instruction; shared general methods are permitted but solved subanswers are not presented as fresh evidence.
